caption: The drawing features a single object positioned centrally against a plain, off-white or light beige background. The object is a flat, iron trivet with a rust-brown coloration, shaped in a nearly rectangular form with rounded top edges. The trivet's interior design incorporates large, stylized capital letters "S," "A," and "I" arranged artistically so that the curved "S" dominates the center, intersected by a capital "A" above its middle and a vertical "I" extending downward through the middle of the "A" and "S." The trivet includes several oval-shaped cutouts in its frame. At the lower right of the drawing, the name "Margaret Golden" is inscribed in small, simple lettering. There is a visible strip of fabric tape near the top edge of the page, on the top left and right corners.
title: Trivet
